node.name: Comedian Jon Rudnitsky (SNL, Netflix, HBO) Headlines The Riot Comedy Club
node.description: Jon Rudnitsky can be seen in the upcoming films INTO THE SKY with Sam Richardson and SUPER TROOPERS 3, and currently in I LOVE YOU FOREVER on HBO, Netflix’s OUR LITTLE SECRET with Lindsay Lohan, and Amazon’s THE RED ONE opposite Dwayne Johnson.He was the sole new cast member hired for the 41st season of Saturday Night Live. His screen credits include starring opposite George Clooney in Hulu’s CATCH-22, playing Young Larry in the latest season of CURB YOUR ENTHUSIASM, and starring opposite Reese Witherspoon in Nancy Meyers’ HOME AGAIN. Additional film work includes Edward Burns’ SUMMER DAYS AND SUMMER NIGHTS, Netflix’s SET IT UP, Tyler Perry’s NOBODY’S FOOL, and THE YOUNG WIFE with Kiersey Clemons and Judith Light. He also voices principal roles in Disney’s WISH and Paramount’s UNDER THE BOARDWALK.On television, he starred in Fox’s THE BIG LEAP and has appeared on NBC’s CHAMPIONS, Disney’s BIG HERO 6, Amazon’s RED OAKS, and the Broken Lizard series TACOMA FD.As a stand-up comedian, Rudnitsky has appeared on CONAN and Comedy Central’s THE COMEDY JAM, where he performed “Footloose” with Kenny Loggins. He tours nationally and was selected as a “New Face” at the Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal.He graduated from USC’s BFA Acting Conservatory, where he received the John Ritter Memorial Award for Outstanding Comedic Performance. Born and raised in New Jersey, he now lives in New York City and performs regularly at The Comedy Cellar.All shows Ages 21 & Up. Photo ID Required for Entry. node.description: Join us for a hilarious evening of laughter with Will Abeles at The Riot Comedy Club!Will Abeles is a nationally touring comedian, producer and podcaster based out of Nashville, TN. node.name: Comedian Shane Torres (The Late Show, Comedy Central) Headlines The Riot Houston
node.description: Shane Torres is a standup comedian, writer, podcaster, and sometimes actor who lives in Brooklyn, New York. As a standup comedian Shane has appeared on CONAN (twice), THE LATE SHOW WITH STEPHEN COLBERT, NBC’S LAST COMIC STANDING, HALF HOUR SPECIAL WITH COMEDY CENTRAL, and THIS WEEK FROM THE CELLAR on Comedy Central just to name a few. He released his debut album "Established 1981" with Comedy Central records to rave reviews in 2018.You can see him touring all around the world at comedy clubs, concert venues, and some of the most prestigious festivals. Shane has been heard on popular podcasts such as BERTCAST, COMEDY BANG BANG, ALL FANTASY EVERYTHING, GUYS WE FUCKED, SAVAGE LOVE PODCAST, DOUG LOVES MOVIES, RISK and a slew of more. His podcast NO ACCOUNTING FOR TASTE with Kyle Kinane is available via ALL THINGS COMEDY wherever you get your podcasts. Shane has been seen acting alongside household names for NBC’S RED NOSE DAY and on IFC’S COMEDY BANG BANG. In 2019 Shane was one of a handful of comedians invited to perform on Will Smith’s THIS JOKA. Shane has also hosted his own series for Comedy Central called SHANE TORRES CONQUERS YOUR FEARS and a show for Paramount Plus named HOW GOOD CAN IT GET WITH SHANE TORRES. Shane has also been seen as a panelist on multiple television shows across a variety of networks. He has been reviewed by numerous media outlets including The New York Times, Onion AV Club, GQ UK, and more.“Mr. Torres has a laconic drawling delivery with deliberate pacing, placing him firmly in the tradition of dry deadpan specialists like Tig Notaro and Todd Barry. But his style is warmer, relying on punchlines with corkscrew turns that have moments of vulnerability and even melancholy.” — The New York Times.All shows Ages 21 & Up. Photo ID Required for Entry. node.name: Jay Badlani (Don't Tell Comedy) Headlines The Riot Comedy Club
node.description: Jay Badlani is a stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in Atlanta, GA. Known for his unflinching attitude and sharp, charismatic voice, Jay has built one of the more impressive digital followings in the independent comedy space, with over 200 million views and 200,000+ followers across his platforms through a steady output of live stand-up and online content.A regular at the Laughing Skull Lounge, Jay is a fixture of the Atlanta comedy scene while simultaneously headlining rooms across the country. Recent and ongoing performances have taken him to Mic Drop Comedy in Arizona, The Lincoln Lodge in Chicago, and various Don't Tell Comedy showcases, alongside a recurring series of his own, Jay Badlani and Friends, which he produces and headlines in Atlanta.A respected festival presence, Jay is an alumnus of the Laughing Skull Comedy Festival, Red Clay Fest, Rogue Island Comedy Festival, and the North Carolina Comedy Festival. He has shared the stage with Jeff Garlin, Clayton English, and Dina Hashem.All shows Ages 21 & Up. Photo ID Required for Entry. node.name: Michael Rowland (HBOmax, Late Night with Jimmy Fallon, Comedy Central) Headlines The Riot Comedy Club
node.description: Michael Rowland stars as Shred in the new hit FOX comedy “Animal Control,” alongside Joel McHale. Originally from Atlanta, GA, he is a New York-based stand-up comedian and actor. He made his late-night TV debut on The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon and in 2022 he was honored as a New Face at the Just For Laughs Comedy Festival in Montreal. He’s been featured multiple times on “This Week at the Comedy Cellar” on Comedy Central, as well as “Stupid Questions” with Chris DiStefano and “Pause with Sam Jay” on HBOMax. He also has a feature set for Comedy Central Digital, and in 2019 he was a finalist in the &quot;New York&#39;s Funniest Stand Up&quot; competition for New York Comedy Festival. Known for his unique take on life, Michael’s comedy is as grounded as it is unpredictable, blending southern warmth with the edge of NYC’s comedy scene. Whether he’s cracking up audiences at the Comedy Cellar in New York or on his sitcom “Animal Control,” Michael’s laid-back style and genuine personality make every performance unforgettable.All shows Ages 21 & Up. He has performed at the Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal, as well as  SXSW, Moontower, New York Comedy and Sketchfest festivals, and has opened for Tim Dillon, Mark Normand, Hasan Minhaj, and Ronnie Chieng. node.name: Brittany Ross (Netflix is a Joke fest, Don't Tell Comedy) Headlines The Riot Houston
node.description: Brittany Ross is a Los Angeles based standup comedian, actress, and writer who is celebrated for her dynamic performances nationwide. A regular at the iconic Hollywood Improv and Don’t Tell Comedy shows, she tackles culture and identity with her unique voice and razor sharp wit. Raised around a whirlwind of cultures – Alaska, Scotland, South America, Texas, Chicago, and Hawaii – she explores life on the other end of a dysfunctional childhood where she was forced to build comfort within chaos. Not only does her comedy dive into the hilarious clash between her eccentric working-class Southern family and her Swiss husband’s affluent family lifestyle, but also shines a light on the added identity challenges accompanying motherhood. Ross’s talent has garnered her spots on stage at Big Pine and Netflix is a Joke Festivals, and landed her roles on screen in hit shows Mythic Quest, Huge in France, The Middle, and 2 Broke Girls. With her relatable storytelling and infectious energy, she captivates audiences and leaves them wanting more.All shows Ages 21 & Up. He has also been featured on NPR’s This American Life.His television, writing, and other credits include Late Night with Seth Meyers, The Gilly and Keeves Sketch Show, Comedy Central’s Crank Yankers, HBO Max’s Pause with Sam Jay, Netflix’s Waffles + Mochi, TBS’ The Last O.G., as well as writing for multiple Comedy Central Roasts. He currently resides in Brooklyn with his cat Samson.All shows Ages 21 & Up. Photo ID Required for Entry. --Looking for the fun thing to do in Houston? Whether you’re planning a fun date night, a night out with friends, or just want to meet new people, Riot Comedy Club is the perfect destination!Top-Tier Comedy ShowsExperience hilarious stand-up performances featuring the funniest comedians you’ve seen on Netflix, HBO, Comedy Central, and at iconic venues like the Comedy Store and Comedy Cellar. with 4.9 Star rating on Google with over 5500 Google reivews!Delicious Food & DrinksEnjoy tasty food, draught beer, wine, and handcrafted cocktails—all served in our intimate and casual setting.A Unique Night OutSkip the usual bars and movies! Laugh, connect, and make memories at Houston’s best comedy club.Join us for an unforgettable evening filled with laughter, great vibes, and the best live comedy Houston has to offer.Book your tickets now!#FunThingToDoInHouston #HoustonComedyClub #DateNightHouston #HoustonNightlife #StandupComedyHouston

node.description: He began his comedic odyssey back when he was growing up in Ottawa Canada at Yuk Yuk's Comedy Cabaret and Absolute Comedy Club. Since then he has appeared in many venues in Europe and New York, including, Times Square Arts Centre (former Laugh Factory), and the Comedy Village NYC. Graham has also appeared in various small films as well as television appearances for VBS.TV. and the CBC. And when he is not busy proving his elementary teachers wrong, that you can in fact work as a class clown, you can find him at the local bar practicing how to drink a beer.

Jon’s best known for his White VS Hispanic skits, however Jon first started doing comedy in July of 2011. What started off as making his family laugh on road trips, soon led to him stumbling upon Chris Farley and stand up comedy, which eventually led to him pursuing a full time career in stand up. After getting involved in the local comedy scene in Austin, Jon quickly found success through the release of multiple comedy skits which went viral receiving millions of views on Facebook and shortly after, TikTok. Since then Jon has toured all over the country performing his live standup show while also growing his fan base through social media. He’s currently working on his new hour and is getting it as close to perfection as possible for his new nationwide tour in 2027. node.name: Lace Larrabee (America's Got Talent, Sirius XM) Headlines The Riot Comedy Club
node.description: If you haven’t heard of Lace Larrabee, you will soon. Lace is a nationally touring comedian, actor, and host whose debut comedy album, White Trash Cinderella, produced by 800 Pound Gorilla Records, sealed the number one spot on the comedy charts. The accompanying YouTube special amassed over 2 million views and counting. She’s a comedy favorite on Sirius XM and a regular celebrity guest on tv’s 25 Words or Less. A former southern beauty queen, Lace ditched the pageants but kept her dominant stage presence, unrivaled timing and trademark sass. As a season 17 semifinalist on America’s Got Talent, America loved her charming wit so much, NBC brought her back to roast Simon Cowell alongside Roastmaster General himself, Jeff Ross. Lace turned her appearance on AGT into a Vegas residency as host of America’s Got Talent Superstars Live. For over a decade, Lace has been honing her self-deprecating humor and hilarious personal anecdotes into a style that is fiercely her own. Lace can captivate a room and garner laughs as big as her personality. From tales of growing up in a trailer to relatable observations on friends, family, love and aging, Lace turns life’s humiliating moments into an indomitable act of comedy. Lace’s candor, perspicacity, and refreshingly real takes on life leave audiences wanting to be best friends with her.---ALL SHOWS ARE AGES 21 & UP. NO DRINK MINIMUMS.

node.name: Comedian Steve Byrne (The Late Show & Jimmy Kimmel) Live in Conroe
node.description: Riot Comedy Conroe Presents Comedian Steve Byrne Live in ConroeDon’t miss your chance to catch the best live standup in Downtown Conroe at the city’s newest comedy hotspot! Featuring some of the funniest comedians from across Texas and the country.Welcome to Riot Comedy Conroe - Your New Weekend Destination for Laughter!Get ready for an unforgettable night of standup at GuadalaHARRY’s Bar & Grill, where Riot Comedy brings top-tier comedians, delicious food, cold drinks, and a vibrant atmosphere to the heart of Downtown Conroe. Enjoy a relaxed, energetic setting perfect for comedy fans, couples, groups, and anyone looking for a great night out.Over the last few years, comedian Steve Byrne has solidified his status as one of the most innovative, versatile and established entertainers working in his field. From starting his career at established clubs in NYC likeThe Comedy Cellar and Gotham to cementing his work ethic in LA atThe Comedy Store and The Improv, his career has ascended to a national touring act backed by an impressive resume.Apart from being a late night talk show regular: “Conan”, “Jimmy Kimmel” “The LateLate Show”, even appearing on “The Tonight Show” 10 times, Steve starred, produced and wrote on his own sitcom that ran for 3 seasons on TBS, “Sullivan & Son” producedby Vince Vaughn and Peter Billingsley. node.name: Comedian Maggie Hughes Live in Conroe
node.description: Maggie Hughes DePalo is a Chicago comedian, born and raised on the city’s southside. After getting married and starting a family, Maggie pursued stand-up comedy when she realized it’s a lot more fun than ‘book club’. Her deadpan style and sarcastic storytelling about marriage, motherhood and mammograms has won over audiences of all ages. Maggie has 140K+ social followers, 30M+ views on Instagram & TikTok, with several viral clips landing her on Inside Edition, Yahoo News, The New York Post, Daily Mail, Business Insider & Fox News.  Maggie performs regularly at Zanies Chicago where she sold out 3 shows in her headlining debut. She recently performed for Nateland’s “The Showcase, Season 3”. In 2026, Maggie was the first female comedian to feature on Nate Bargatze’s Arena tour. She is also the co-founder of ALL THAT GOOD STUFF, a comedy showcase and production company.ALL SHOWS ARE AGES 21 & UP. NO DRINK MINIMUMS.--

node.description: Sophie Buddle is a stand-up, a TV writer, and a podcaster. She has just wrapped as the head monologue writer for “After Midnight with Taylor Tomlinson.” She has also appeared on “The Tonight Show”, “The Late Late Show with James Corden”, and on CBC’s “This Hour Has 22 Minutes as a correspondent and staff writer. She&#39;s also been featured on CTV’s &quot;Roast Battle&quot;, JFL All Access, Kevin Hart&#39;s LOL Network, the Winnipeg Comedy Festival and the Halifax Comedy Festival. She was a featured performer at the Just For Laughs Comedy Festival in Montreal and in 2022 had the esteemed privilege of delivering the Canadian Keynote Address on Comedy. Sophie released her first album in 2019, &quot;Lil Bit Of Buddle,&quot; which won the 2020 Juno Award for Best Comedy Album of the Year, making her the first female comic to win that award. She released the album herself so you can find it on iTunes in the genre &quot;easy listening&quot;, which was a mistake, but it is easy to listen to, so it&#39;s OK. Her podcast &quot;Obsessed with Sophie Buddle&quot;, which tackles people’s obsessions (from Beyoncé to American politics to checking if the door is locked to revenge) is currently available on Apple Podcasts. node.name: Comedian Ron G (HBO) Headlines The Riot Houston
node.description: Emmy® Award-winning producer, actor, and stand-up powerhouse Ron G is a rare, multi-hyphenate talent whose career is defined by high-octane energy and a "no-miss" reputation. node.name: Jeremy Alder (Sirius XM) Headlines The Riot Comedy Club
node.description: Jeremy Alder is a warm, dry, delightfully irreverent comedian with the vibe of a former church kid finally saying, "Y'all aren't ready for this conversation... but here we go." Raised homeschooled in a deeply religious Texas family, he now turns that world into quietly audacious, deceptively sharp comedy—exploring faith, doubt, marriage, parenting, and growing up "Texas" with a calm, precise delivery that draws audiences into conversations they didn't expect but can't stop laughing through.Headlining nationwide, Jeremy’s Dry Bar Comedy special has earned over 7 million views; he's been featured on Nate Bargatze's Nateland Presents, and he's in regular rotation on SiriusXM. His debut album,Almost a Grown Man, and his online series, Christians Who Don't Suck, showcase the same probing humor that's cemented his place as comedy's favorite soft-spoken agent of chaos. If you like your comedy hilarious, thoughtful, and a little spicy, Jeremy's your guy.ALL SHOWS ARE AGES 21 & UP. TWO(2) DRINK MINIMUM INCLUSIVE OF NON-ALCOHOLIC DRINKS---

node.name: Comedian Ivan Decker (Netflix, Conan) Live in Conroe
node.description: Known for his sharp, polished, and multi-layered observational comedy, Ivan Decker continues to achieve success as a writer, stand-up, and actor. After being named “A Comic to Watch” at the New York Comedy Festival, Netflix then released his Comedy Special, “Underwater Scissors” to rave reviews. Ivan made his American television debut on “Conan” and his comedy album “I Wanted to be a Dinosaur” was the recipient of the JUNO award for “Comedy Album of the Year.” He can be seen and heard on the popular CBC radio program “The Debaters” and his newest special, “Popcorn,” was released by 800 Pound Gorilla Media and was nominated for a 2025 JUNO Award for "Comedy Album of the Year."ALL SHOWS ARE AGES 21 & UP.
